description: Design of BRBs for and Collapse Performance of Strongback Braced Frames with Varying BRB Configurations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Mark Denavit, University of Tennessee Knoxville (utk.edu). An overturning design procedure for BRBs was developed and evaluated. A simplified model with a rigid strongback was used to evaluate a broad set of input configurations. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: steel braced frames, strongback braced frames, buckling-restrained braces, design, nonlinear analysis. Published 2024-09-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
